name: Team Charmander: Sevii Pyre Vanguard
archetype: Sevii oceanic traversal & Chuck duel core — Electric/Psychic speed sweeping, Air Slash coverage, Sleep status suppression, Intimidate pivoting, and Ground/Fighting wallbreaking.
gym_duel_rationale: For Chuck's 5 vs 5 duel, Slots 1 through 5 enter the fray: Alakazam/Raichu (Slot 2) sweeps with 120 SpA STAB Psychic against Chuck's Fighting core and STAB Thunderbolt to electrocute Blaziken/Wailord; Charizard/Venusaur (Slot 1) uses Sleep Powder to suppress setup sweepers, STAB Petal Dance against Kabutops/Machamp, and super-effective Air Slash; Gyarados/Nidoking (Slot 5) cuts Chuck's physical Attack on entry with Intimidate; Lapras (Slot 3) walls incoming water moves with Water Absorb and provides Ice Beam coverage; and Primeape/Sandslash (Slot 4) wallbreaks with Close Combat and Earthquake. Snorlax rests in reserve as the route endurance tank.

roster.progression_notes: 530 BST hybrid anchor at Cap 72. Sleep Powder neutralizes dangerous setup sweepers immediately. Air Slash lands super-effective STAB Flying damage against Chuck's Fighting core, while Petal Dance melts Kabutops/Machamp.

500 BST speed demon with 120 SpA. STAB Thunderbolt vaporizes ocean water spawns and Blaziken/Wailord. STAB Psychic decimates Kabutops/Machamp, Poliwrath/Primeape, Lucario/Flygon, and Hitmonchan/Snorlax.
535 BST Water/Ice fortress. Water Absorb completely negates opposing water attacks across Brine Road and Deep Sea. STAB Ice Beam targets Lucario/Flygon for heavy super-effective damage.
477 BST physical wallbreaker. STAB Earthquake crushes Rock and Electric encounters, while Close Combat breaks bulky Normal and Steel targets with immense force.
522 BST Intimidate pivot. Cuts Chuck's physical Attack on entry to blunt incoming Dynamic Punches and Close Combats. STAB Aqua Tail washes away ground and rock threats.
Colossal 160 HP route sponge holding Leftovers. RestTalk loop absorbs deep-sea status and damage during exploration while resting in reserve during the 5v5 Gym duel.

flex_bench.rationale: High-speed Flying pivot providing team speed acceleration and super-effective Flying STAB.
Ground-immune physical wall packing Sludge Bomb and Will-O-Wisp for burn suppression.
Iron Fist-boosted elemental punches provide custom physical coverage against diverse route encounters.
